prompt: CHALLENGE: Why is crown ether 18-crown-6 particularly effective at solubilizing K⁺ salts in nonpolar solvents?

options.label: The cavity size of 18-crown-6 is a near-perfect match for K⁺'s ionic radius; six ether oxygens coordinate the K⁺ while the hydrocarbon exterior is solvent-compatible.
The crown ether is negatively charged.
It reduces K⁺ to K metal.
The crown is more polar than most solvents.

explanation: The '18' is the ring size; '6' is the number of oxygens. 18-crown-6 has a cavity (~2.6 Å) that matches K⁺ (~2.7 Å). It wraps around K⁺ like a lifesaver, exposing the hydrophobic CH₂CH₂ exterior to the solvent. 12-crown-4 fits Li⁺; 15-crown-5 fits Na⁺.
